cases.name: full: every report, one restricted artifact withheld
cases.notes: Import it as one snapshot. Show the evidence as current, RULE-ASMT-AUTH nowhere, and the withheld counts where lists were shortened.

cases.name: the same snapshot exported again later
cases.notes: Same commit and graph hash as full.json, later generatedAt: re-importing it must not duplicate a snapshot, an artifact or an association.

cases.name: minimal: no reports, no commit
cases.notes: Show evidence, knowledge, impact and ownership as not supplied, never as none, zero or passing, and say there is no commit and why.

cases.name: evidence from an earlier snapshot only
cases.notes: Show TEST-ASMT-SCHEDULE as stale for this snapshot, not as passing, though its latest run passed.

cases.name: evidence judged by subject, current
cases.notes: The report says the repository judges by subject (the default, since slices claim files). The review was made at another commit and graph hash, and is a current pass because its subjectHash equals the verification's subject in the report: show TEST-ASMT-SCHEDULE as passing, with the binding that judged it, not as stale for being at an older commit.

cases.name: evidence judged by subject, stale because the subject moved
cases.notes: The review's subjectHash is not the verification's subject, so it is stale; the note names the part that moved, a file the verified behavior's slice claims. Show it as stale with that note, never as passing, and not as failing.

cases.name: evidence judged by commit for want of slice claims
cases.notes: The only slice is retired, so no slice claims files and there is no subject to bind to: the report says the binding is commit and fell back (bindingReason no-slices, EVID004), which a repository that asked for commit binding does not say. A record at the snapshot's commit and graph hash is a current pass, as in 0.3. The files the retired slice claimed are now claimed by none, so validation fails for that reason; the snapshot is imported as failing, with the evidence shown beside it.

cases.name: a failing validation still exports
cases.notes: Import it and label the snapshot as failing validation; the diagnostics say why. Evidence and ownership are not supplied.

cases.name: restricted artifacts included on request
cases.notes: Nothing is withheld. A consumer that accepts this must enforce restricted visibility itself before any search or display.

cases.name: a Markset diagnostic, with Markset's own code
cases.notes: A record's columns block has one column, which Markset reports as COLUMNS_SINGLE with origin syntax. Accept it: Markset's codes are AREA_NAME, not AREA###, and are shown as written, never renamed. A warning leaves validation passing.

cases.name: the earlier contract version
cases.notes: 0.1 had untyped reports and exported restricted artifacts. Reject it with an understandable error and keep the prior snapshot.

cases.name: an earlier contract version
cases.notes: 0.2 had no measure type, no evidenceSources registry and no measure or tips on an artifact. A reader of a later version rejects it rather than guess what an outcome's measures were.

cases.name: the previous contract version
cases.notes: 0.3 judged every record by commit and carried no binding, subject or exercises. A 0.4 reader rejects it, with the version it supports in the message, and keeps the prior snapshot, rather than read a stale status the repository's own check may not have reached; the consumer upgrades its pin and its reader together.

cases.name: a later contract version
cases.notes: A version this consumer was not built for is rejected, however familiar the rest looks.

cases.name: an export cut off in transit
cases.notes: Reject it; a partial import must not replace the prior snapshot.

cases.name: an artifact without a title
cases.notes: Reject the whole envelope, not just that artifact.

cases.name: another repository's export
cases.notes: The connection is for example/elsewhere; an export of example/scheduling must not be imported into it.

cases.name: a product the export does not contain
cases.notes: The connection is for PRD-HARBOR, which this export does not contain.

cases.name: an evidence report from another snapshot
cases.notes: The evidence report was computed at another commit and graph hash than the envelope: snapshots must not be mixed.

cases.name: a pass from an old graph hash labelled current
cases.notes: A current-pass whose deciding run is from another snapshot contradicts itself; never show it as passing.

cases.name: a current pass whose record is bound to another subject
cases.notes: A subject-bound current-pass is current only while the record's subjectHash equals the verification's subject in the report. Here they differ, so the status contradicts the report: never show it as passing.

cases.name: a restricted artifact in an export that says restricted is withheld
cases.notes: Reject it before anything is stored or indexed, so no title or path of the restricted artifact is disclosed.

cases.name: a passing status over errors
cases.notes: The status says pass and the counts say otherwise; a consumer must not show a green status it cannot trust.
